description: Our proposed two-storey wood-framed detached home with a building area of 200 m2 has an 18 m clear-span structural roof member. We want to keep the design entirely within the ordinary Part 9 framing tables, without designing the framing and fastening to the Part 4 wood-design provisions. The rest of the house uses closely spaced lumber framing. What should our application address?
known_facts: no design of framing and fastening to Part 4 wood provisions

risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents

gold.departure: Wood framing beyond the structural-span scope is not designed under the required Part 4 wood-design route.

should_cite.why: The 12.20 m span limit is part of the scope.
Required wood structural design standard on the Part 4 route.

gold.engineering_reason: The stated span exceeds the Part 9 framing scope, whose next sentence directs this wood design to Part 4; that design requires a registered professional.
